smart-money-concepts.title: Stop Chasing Candles. Start Reading the Market.
smart-money-concepts.description: A companion article that reinforces the book's core idea: stop reacting to isolated candles and read market structure, liquidity, displacement and context instead.

machine-learning-interviews-visually-exp.title: 250 Machine Learning Interview Questions — Visually Explained
machine-learning-interviews-visually-exp.description: A companion article for the book, presenting a visual, concept-first way to prepare for machine learning interviews and reinforcing the book's 250-question interview-preparation framework.

0dte-options.title: 0DTE Options Trading: Why You Can Predict the Market Correctly and Still Lose Money
0dte-options.description: A companion article for 0DTE Options: Trading the Same-Day Market, explaining why directional accuracy alone is not enough when same-day options are dominated by rapid time decay, changing Greeks, execution quality and risk.
